description: List tasks across every matter you can open, or in one with matterId, soonest due date first and undated tasks last. By default only your own open tasks: assignee 'any' lists everyone's and 'unassigned' those nobody has, openOnly=false keeps done and cancelled ones, and dateTo keeps tasks due on or before that day (with openOnly, the overdue ones). Each item names its matter (id, name, reference). Paginate with limit and cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
